request.text: select pivotinfo from sysreportpivot where controller = @controller and id = @id

declare @id int select @id = isnull(max(id), 0) + 1 from sysreportpivot where controller = @controller --user_id = @@userId and set @reportForm = rtrim(@id) + @reportForm insert into sysreportpivot select @@userId, @id, @controller, 0, @name, @name2, @reportForm, 1, getdate(), getdate(), @@userId, @@userId select '' as message, 'filter$saveReportPivot$Saved(p, ''' + rtrim(@reportForm) + ''')' as script

declare @pid int; set @pid = dbo.sf_GetWordNum(replace(@reportForm, '|', ','), 1) if not exists(select 1 from sysreportpivot where id = @pid and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller) begin select '$ReportPivotNotEdit' as message, 'name' as field return end update sysreportpivot set pivotinfo = @reportForm, formname = @name, formname2 = @name2 where id = @pid and user_id = @@userId and controller = @controller select '' as message, 'filter$saveReportPivot$Saved(p, ''' + rtrim(@reportForm) + ''')' as script
